card.name: Opening bracket before an M-abbreviation
card.fires_on: The open parenthesis after a full term whose abbreviation starts with M (such as mCRPC, MSP, MAC, MAS, MCE). Also the comma before an M-word in an all-caps warning list.

modes.label: Parenthesis before abbreviation
modes.description: An open bracket after a spelled-out name, where the abbreviation that follows begins with M.

modes.label: Comma before M-word
modes.description: A comma in an all-caps boxed warning list just before MALIGNANCY.
modes.example: SERIOUS INFECTIONS, MORTALITY<<,>> MALIGNANCY, MAJOR AD

modes.label: Inside units
modes.description: The part of a unit like mCi, partway through, where the next piece starts with m.

card.writes: It pushes the next token to be an m or M, such as the start of an M-abbreviation.
card.plain: It fires where the next thing written is likely an abbreviation or word starting with M.
